changelog: New: Pasting a Pinterest board or profile link and clicking Add now finds every Pin in the background and adds them to the download list automatically — no extra dialog, and the window stays responsive
New: pin.it short links are resolved automatically — a single Pin adds one item, a board or profile is expanded like any other
Improved: Pinterest discovery progress shows in the status bar ("Discovering pins…", then how many were found, added and skipped as duplicates)
Improved: Pinterest board/profile discovery can be stopped with Pause All or Clear All, and always finishes within a fixed time limit
